title: Citizen Hearing on Disclosure
summary: Jake Barber tells of Citizen Hearing on Disclosure, about 2013 at not stated, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I recommend going to the what was called the citizens hearings in 2013. It's on YouTube.

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he once carried a UFO with his helicopter, recommends on Jesse Michels's podcast that people watch what he calls the Citizen Hearing of 2013. As he describes it, these were hearings about "disclosure", meaning governments revealing what they know about non-human intelligence, and the recordings are on YouTube. He points to them as a place where earlier testimony on the subject was gathered.
